meta.title: The Proof of This Space's Decoherence - 1

units.rawText: I look at the man lying on the ground. He looks to be around 20 or so and wears a white coat. Both his clothing and hairstyle mark him as being out of place in Magrasea.

units.rawText: He has no combat modules and his neural cloud shows no sign of Entropy virus infection, so we don't need to worry about him posing a threat for the time being.
